title: B175 — Loop library: catalog reusable agentic loops (workflows-as-prompts)
description:
Catalog the lab's reusable AI-agent **loops** — structured prompt-workflows with checkpoints and explicit stopping conditions — modeled on the Forward Future Loop Library.

**What a "loop" is:** a reusable agent workflow = a detailed prompt with built-in checkpoints + terminal conditions (stopping rules that prevent runaway loops / wasted cycles). Each catalog entry: title · category (Engineering / Operations / Evaluation / Content / Design) · description · the full prompt · terminal condition.

**Why for the lab:** the lab already runs many repeatable agentic loops ad-hoc — the DoD 8-pillar pass, code-scan-suite triage, the pr-lifecycle reconcile (B131), golden-path verify (B153/B160), the eval loops (B84/B96), the operator incident sweep (B45/B66), machine-inventory onboarding (B169). Codifying them as a versioned, discoverable library gives repeatability + a stopping-condition discipline that matches the Claude Code `/loop` command's self-pacing.

**Where it fits (evaluate):** the lab already has the **Bifrost prompt repo** (`register_bifrost_prompts.py`) + **skills repo** (`register_bifrost_skills.py`) — a loop library is the natural extension (a loop = a prompt with a terminal condition). The `/loop` command + the AIDLC stages are also loop-shaped. Decide: register loops into Bifrost as the SoT vs. a curated docs catalog vs. both; seed with the lab's existing recurring workflows.

**Deliverable:** a loop library (SoT + discovery surface) seeded with the lab's real recurring workflows, each with an explicit terminal condition. $0 (existing Bifrost / docs infra).

Ref: [https://signals.forwardfuture.com/loop-library/](<https://signals.forwardfuture.com/loop-library/>)
